summary: Ramaswamy framed Israel in religious and destined terms, told a Las Vegas audience Israel is "strong" and doesn't need U.S. defense, and said he would love for the IDF to put the heads of the top 100 Hamas leaders on stakes along the Gaza border. After backlash over a Free Beacon remark suggesting reduced U.S. military aid to Israel by 2028, he told Fox News the U.S.-Israel relationship would be "stronger than it ever has been" as a "true friendship."
